title: MadMobs
description: Passive mobs become aggressive and hunt players with customizable damage, speed, and AI behavior.
body:
# 🐔 MadMobs 🐔

Turn Minecraft’s peaceful world into complete chaos.

MadMobs transforms passive mobs into hostile creatures that actively hunt nearby players. Villagers, cows, sheep, pigs, wolves, and many other normally harmless mobs will chase, attack, and overwhelm players using customizable AI behavior.

Built for survival servers, hardcore gameplay, SMP events, and chaotic challenge worlds.

---

## ⚙ Features

### Aggressive Passive Mobs
Passive mobs no longer ignore players. They actively chase and attack using configurable movement speeds and damage values.

### Fully Configurable
Every mob can be individually customized inside the config:

- Enable or disable specific mobs
- Customize attack damage
- Customize movement speed
- Adjust global attack range

### 🐺 Enhanced Wolf AI
Wolves enter an angry state with glowing red eyes while attacking players, while still remaining tameable using bones.

### 🧑 Smart Villager Behavior
Villagers will attack players during the day but remain peaceful while sleeping in beds at night.

### 👥 Multiplayer Friendly
Designed with optimized mob scanning and targeting systems to reduce unnecessary server load while keeping aggressive mob behavior responsive.

### 💪 Lightweight & Optimized
MadMobs avoids heavy global entity processing and uses optimized targeting logic to help maintain smooth server performance on multiplayer worlds.

---

## 🤖 Commands

```txt
/madmobs on
/madmobs off
